evidence_resolution.rationale: All three required evidence-stalled issues stall on missing registered-lane measurement, not on missing probe internals: the replay never clicks the trigger, golden_path_observation hardcodes state=unavailable, and no external focusboard:// drive exists. The candidate-side infrastructure still missing is drivability and capture-readiness: a reliably clickable trigger, a signed-in terminal state that keeps the six surfaces reachable after pass, failure diagnostics, and readable deeplink counters. This task builds exactly that; the replay extension, observation promotion, external activation drives, and advisory calibration are assigned to Host follow-up in deferred_items, and acceptance for the three issues is thereby re-scoped to one extended-replay receipt bound to the new candidate hash instead of another unmeasured probe-only loop.

tasks.instructions: Bind the golden-path lane to the receipt the Host gate announced. First, trigger drivability: keep start trigger-only (no auto-run at startup or on navigator.webdriver detection, no credentials in DOM or logs) but make #golden-path-trigger reliably clickable by a standard WebDriver element click from the anonymous smoke end state — adjust hit target, aria-hidden, or pointer semantics as needed without turning it into a visible product control. Second, terminal contract: after a passing drive the app must remain signed in as the drive account on a stable surface (Today) instead of the current restore_shell sign-out, so Today, Inbox, Projects, Calendar, Focus, and Settings stay reachable through the primary nav (data-testid nav-*) for post-drive per-surface capture; the drive must still prove sign_out, sign-in-again, and persistence checks before reaching that terminal state. Third, failure containment: on a failed step, data-goldenpath-state=fail with the failing step and reason code must render and the session must stay diagnosable and navigable with no hang or overlay trap. Fourth, keep the deeplink counters (cold-delivered, warm-forwarded, pending, last-outcome) rendered and readable on the probe element through the terminal state. Update golden_path_section3_self_drive and any affected unit tests to assert the new terminal contract while preserving existing coverage; keep the suite green and sources rustfmt-clean; preserve the anonymous validation replay behavior, product_ui_separation pass, and the embedded-assets build. Do not modify host tools: the replay click, observation promotion, external focusboard:// activation drives, and advisory probe calibration are Host follow-up.

risk_note.summary: Most likely insufficient-evidence outcome: the extended replay does not run this loop, so journey completion and per-surface captures again lack a bound receipt and this task's runtime value stays unit-proven only; a second risk is that the first-ever live signed-in captures expose visual or state defects on surfaces never before photographed.
risk_note.validation: The Developer proves the terminal contract through updated unit tests and focused self-validation; the host-observed receipt and per-surface captures are recorded in validation as Host-owned recapture and are never claimed as developer evidence.
risk_note.why_now: The Host has scheduled the replay extension and requires one receipt with passed=16 of 16, product_ui_separation=pass, and signed-in surface captures bound to the next candidate hash; the current terminal sign-out and borderline 6x6 trigger target would sink exactly that receipt.
